subject: Pyknotic objects
object: (hyper)sheaves on the site of compacta, valued in a category C

subject: Pyknotic set
object: small sheaf of sets on Comp with respect to the effective epimorphism topology, Pyk(Set) := Sh_eff(Comp; Set)

subject: Pyk(Set)
object: Pyk(Set) is a coherent 1-topos whose coherent objects are exactly the compacta

subject: Compactly generated topological spaces
object: full subcategory CG of small topological spaces, the smallest containing Comp and closed under small colimits

subject: Compactly generated topological spaces embedding into pyknotic sets
object: Yoneda embedding of compactly generated spaces into Pyk(Set) is fully faithful, expressing CG as a localisation of Pyk(Set)

subject: Colimit of compactly generated spaces in pyknotic sets
object: colim_n j(X_n) -> j(colim_n X_n) is an equivalence in Pyk(Set) when the colimit in TSpc is T_1

subject: Pyk(Set)
object: Pyk(Set) is compactly generated and Comp embeds into compact objects, giving Ind(Comp) embedded fully faithfully in Pyk(Set)

subject: Products of quotients in pyknotic sets
object: products of quotients are again quotients in pyknotic sets

subject: Indiscrete pyknotic object A^indisc
object: indiscrete pyknotic object attached to any set, group, space or category A

subject: Discrete pyknotic object A^disc
object: discrete pyknotic object attached to any set, group, space or category A

subject: Cokernel Ẑ/Z in pyknotic groups
object: the cokernel Ẑ/Z in pyknotic groups is not indiscrete

subject: Forgetful functor on pyknotic structures
object: the forgetful functor from pyknotic objects to underlying objects is not faithful

subject: E-nilpotent completion of a spectrum
object: the E-nilpotent completion of a spectrum is naturally a pyknotic spectrum

subject: Indiscrete topological space {0,1}
object: {0,1} with indiscrete topology, as a sheaf on Comp, is pyknotic but not condensed

subject: Pyknotic sets
object: the category Pyk(Set) is a topos, whereas the category of condensed sets is not

subject: Bhatt–Scholze proétale fundamental group
object: monodromy equivalence for local systems of E-vector spaces

subject: Condensed objects (Clausen–Scholze)
object: pyknotic objects, up to set-theoretic universe choices

subject: Pyknotic sets in universe V_{δ+}
object: condensed sets in universe V_{δ+} (pyknotic sets embed fully faithfully into condensed sets)

subject: Condensed sets in V_δ
object: pyknotic sets in V_{δ+} (condensed sets in V_δ embed fully faithfully into pyknotic sets)

subject: Hypercomplete sheaves Sh^hyp_τ(C)
object: full subcategory of Sh_τ(C) spanned by hypercomplete sheaves

subject: Presite (C,E)
object: pair of a category C with a subcategory E satisfying the listed conditions

subject: β-accessible presite
object: presite with disjoint coproducts, C^op β-accessible, and morphisms of E exhibited as β-filtered limits

subject: Macrotopos
object: category X admitting a left exact macroaccessible localisation of Fun^acc(D, S_δ0) for an accessible category D

subject: Sh^acc_E(C)_δ0 for an accessible presite
object: is a macrotopos

subject: Proposition 1.4.3 (sheaf criterion under left Kan extension)
object: f is a τ_{E_β}-sheaf iff its left Kan extension F is a τ_E-sheaf, for β-accessible presites

subject: Corollary 1.4.5
object: left Kan extension gives an equivalence between Sh_{τ_{E_β}}(C_β)_δ0 and β-accessible sheaves in Sh_{τ_E}(C)_δ0

subject: Ind-profinite sets and higher local fields
object: Kato's use of ind-profinite sets in studying higher local fields

subject: Uniform spaces as pyknotic sets
object: compactly generated uniform spaces embed fully faithfully into pyknotic sets via K ↦ Mor_Unif(K,U)
